title: Persistent ledger erasure barrier and delayed-delivery suppression
scope: Keep a strict tenant/visitor ledger erasure predicate active after physical rewrite and suppress delayed pre-erasure decision/outcome records at queue ingestion before R2 persistence.
non_goals: Partial W06/F06/F18 delayed ledger replay containment only. No shopper capability/deletion generation, stale-cookie/session or socket revocation, strict concurrent cross-store fencing, ring/online learning/D1/AE/log/external suppression, physical-retention SLA, customer, gate or release acceptance.

No automatic barrier expiry or claim that the current/default retention number is approved. D03 transactional authority and D06 retention/re-entry policy remain pending; barriers stay active until a later authorized compatible lifecycle exists.

Three production files and two existing ledger suites only. No hot-path scorer/SDK/session/DO/route changes, new infrastructure, broad suite/build, deployment, cloud, credentials, customer data, commit/push, destructive cleanup or subdelegation.

criteria.description: A strict tenant/visitor tombstone remains an active read predicate after its physical rewrite reaches the configured scan floor. Completion is marked durably without deleting or lowering visitor_id/erased_at; repeated rewrite is idempotent, a crash between audit and completion can finalize on retry, and a later explicit erasure restarts physical progress at a monotonic cutoff. Listed missing/corrupt/mismatched barrier state fails closed. Legacy valid tombstones remain readable.

Ledger queue consumption validates that record tenant and integer timestamp equal the parsed decision/outcome ID carrier and that visitor_id is a bounded subject. It loads active barriers once per represented tenant, drops only matching records at or before erased_at before any batch put, retains other visitors and post-cutoff records, reports suppressed count, and returns ok:false on barrier read/parse failure so the caller retries rather than acknowledging an unsafe persistence. Tenant separation holds for two non-default tenants.

Existing ledger and erasure suites only, inspecting actual synthetic R2 keys/rows for delayed decisions and outcomes before and after rewrite completion, failure and compatible positive paths. Worker exact K1 plus app noEmit/scoped diff; independent exact K1 once and frozen source/proof/import pins. W06.01 overlap is qualified before edits. No concurrent-ingestion, deployed R2, SLO or full W06 claim.

checks.runtime: Installed Node/Vitest; actual ledger consumer/writer/erasure modules with existing synthetic R2 seams. No external network.
checks.workload: Two existing ledger suites only; grouped delayed decision/outcome, persistent barrier, strict carrier/failure/tenant and ordinary batching cases. Worker app noEmit and scoped diff; no engine latency claim.

checks.command: Independent frozen W06.02 actual source and complete worker proof review; exact K1 once; relevant local import graph and physical pins; retain review-v1.md.
checks.runtime: Independent local frozen artifact review; actual modules with synthetic R2 only.
checks.workload: C1-C3 persistent suppression and delayed-delivery state, negative carrier/barrier failures and compatibility; inspect compiler/scoped diff evidence without rerun. No broad/deployed qualification.

dependencies.consumed_output: Existing strict tombstone establishment and durable local erasure retry; overlapping erasure source/test proof is retained historically and qualified before edits.
dependencies.rationale: This task changes physical-completion semantics without reopening identity discovery/receipt scope merely to add coverage.

dependencies.consumed_output: Future choice of serialized/transactional cross-store authority.
dependencies.rationale: Persistent ledger suppression does not claim strict prevention of an already in-flight cross-store write.

dependencies.consumed_output: Future approved replay horizon, barrier retention/removal and re-entry policy.
dependencies.rationale: Safety containment keeps the barrier active and does not invent a customer retention duration.
